nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Cucumber Herbal Alcohol Free Toner

segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers with sensitive skin, some also describing rosacea or eczema, report the toner calms and soothes without stinging or burning; one reviewer with dry-combination, slightly sensitive skin instead reports an irritated, burning feeling after repeated use, and another found it less gentle than Kiehl's other toners for her combination/dry skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including several who also describe it as sensitive, consistently report the toner hydrates without the tightness or stripped feeling they associate with other toners.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the toner works well across oily and dry areas without over-drying, including one who calls it a turning point for her skin.
segments.oily: The reviewer with oily, breakout-prone skin reports fewer breakouts and less oiliness since switching to this toner.

concerns.dehydration: The central and most consistent theme is that this alcohol-free toner does not dry out skin the way reviewers expected from a toner, including several with normally dry skin; a few instead say it left their skin feeling irritated or did not feel especially hydrating.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers, including ones with dry, sensitive, or rosacea-prone skin, report reduced redness with regular use over weeks to months.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers report clearer skin or fewer breakouts with regular use, including one with oily, breakout-prone skin; one reviewer instead says the natural oils in the formula made her break out constantly.
concerns.oiliness: The reviewer who identifies as oily-skinned and breakout-prone reports her skin has been less oily since switching to this toner.

aspects.libelle: Bottle cap or lid arrives broken
Good value, bottle lasts a long time
Works well chilled or as a facial mist

extraits.texte: I wanted a toner that was gentle, yet still effective. I noticed that my skin does not respond well to any type of oil -- even the natural oils in this product. I broke out constantly! This made my skin feel sticky and heavy, not for me.

I had high hopes for this based on the description and the great reviews. I was looking for something that would add some hydration to my dry-combo, slightly-sensitive skin, and leave my face feeling refreshed. The first day I tried it I thought I really liked it and left my skin visibly dewy. Every time I have used it since, it has left my skin irritated...almost like a slight burning sensation. I really like the hydrating effects of this, but I can't handle the irritating feeling. Thought I had a bad batch at first because my skin is not all that sensitive. But I researched the ingredients and it could be the campor, which apparently is a known irritant. I wish I knew that before buying.

extraits.titre: Not as gentle as I was expecting
extraits.texte: Label states that this is for dry and sensitive skin, but I would recommend this more for oily or normal skin. Kiehl's calendula and ultra toners are much more gentle and much better for my combo/dry/40's skin. I wish I could return but no kiehls store nearby and don't want to do the hassle of mailing.

I have never used toners related to thinking toners just dry your skin out. My skin is already dry even more in the winter. My skin is sensitive. I received a sample of this toner. It was great my skin actually felt great and didn't dry out. It actually helped my dry, sensitive, roscae skin. Education is key to all things. Plus for me it was great because the scent wasn't strong.

I have dry and sensitive skin, so it's pretty hard to find a toner. This is my 5th already, it works magic on me!! It calms and soothes my skin and redness on my face seems to have reduced since I started using it (about 3 yrs ago i think).

Love this toner. Tried it on a whim, since I have oily skin that can be prone to occasional breakouts. Since I have been using this toner my skin is less oily and I have had virtually zero breakouts. I even bought the larger bottle the second time around. This is a keeper!

extraits.titre: Love love love. The only toner I use now
extraits.texte: I see a lot of mixed reviews. I think maybe this product isn't for people with sensitive skin as it claims but it definitely works on dry skin. I have ezcema and this toner has changed my world for the better! Love it! Use it twice a day.
